parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Join docs via activities.doc_id to obtain PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records via activities.record_id to obtain compound key. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL5251 and standard_type IC50. Require exact values (standard_relation = '=') and non-null standard_value. Require canonical_smiles to be present. Require pubmed_id or doi to be present. Return all specified columns without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
